BiblicalUsage: Dara is named once, among the wise men Solomon surpassed: Ethan the Ezrahite, Heman, Chalcol, and Dara, the sons of Mahol. His name survives because Solomon's wisdom was greater.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse humbles every reputation: even the wisest of a generation are remembered as the measure of someone wiser.
